entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To pull up your account, may I have your full name and order number, please?
The name is Marcus Thorne, order number is VF-8675309. And don't give me the runaround, I'm not in the mood for it.
Thank you for that, Marcus. I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor right here. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I don't like it! It's not what I expected. And don't you dare tell me it's too late or that there's some ridiculous hygiene policy. I want to return it, and I want a manager if you can't do it.
I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager at this point. Let me just quickly check the return policy for your specific item. One moment.
This is ridiculous. I'm already writing a one-star review as we speak. This is the worst service I've ever had.

Thank you for your patience, Marcus. I've confirmed the details. I see you received the item 29 days ago. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard return guidelines, which allow for a return within 90 days of delivery.
Wait... what? So you're going to take it back?

That's correct. You're well within the window. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Do you still have access to that?
Oh. Uh, yeah. Yeah, I do. I was expecting a huge fight. The last company I dealt with was a nightmare over sanitation rules for a return.

I'm sorry you had a difficult experience elsewhere. For this product, our policy is very straightforward. The email with the label has been sent. Just print it out, attach it to the box with the item inside, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued.
Wow. Okay. That... was actually easy. I guess I can hold off on that review. Thank you, Sarah.
You are very welcome, Marcus. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
